must_not: A box left as '[Closed on]' in what is sent; a time like 06:00

steps.action: Pick the language: 'English', 'हिन्दी' or 'Both'
user_sees: Both = English then Hindi; the title is 'English / हिन्दी' when it fits 60 letters, else the English
must_not: A title cut in the middle of a word

steps.action: Send in the app
user_sees: The message in members' apps
must_not: Sent twice; sent to members of another gym

steps.action: Start the WhatsApp list and go down it, one member at a time
user_sees: Members in name order; each opens WhatsApp with the title in bold, the message and the gym's name as the last line; the owner presses send each time; done members are remembered
must_not: A WhatsApp sent by itself; the same number messaged twice; a member skipped without being counted
A step that needs a swipe or a long press, or a button that the keyboard cannot reach

note: On a laptop WhatsApp opens in a new tab; the list must still be there
